title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This sheet is not part of the 1975-76 divided-power de Rham notes. It is page 191 of the typescript of SGA 7 I, Exposé IX (Grothendieck, 'Modèles de Néron et monodromie'), Remarques 14.1.12. Grothendieck apparently wrote the neighbouring manuscript notes on the backs of discarded typescript pages; the archive stamp reads 509.

Setting, in modern language:
- R is a complete discrete valuation ring with fraction field K, and A_K is an abelian variety over K with semistable reduction.
- Via formal geometry (§7), the connected Néron model gives a Raynaud extension G (torus T by abeloid/abelian scheme B), with generic fibre G_K.
- Raynaud's rigid uniformization is the exact sequence 0 → M_K → G_K^an → A_K^an → 0 (14.1.7). Here M is the étale lattice, i^an is the period embedding, and e is the uniformizing map G_K^an → A_K^an.

Remark (a):
- Uniqueness of e is immediate because G_K^an is connected.
- Existence of e is deep, and Grothendieck refers to Raynaud's note.
- The definition of i^an in Raynaud is transcendental (rigid-analytic), although i can be read algebraically via (14.1.5) once G is built.
- Grothendieck says he knows no purely algebro-geometric description of i. He promises an 'arithmetic' characterization in 14.4, obtained by reducing to a situation of finite type over Z.
- He concludes that the period homomorphism is a more hidden structure than those met earlier.

Remark (b):
- i corresponds to a canonical trivialization of the biextension E_K of (M_K, M'_K) by G_m. Equivalently, it corresponds to a homomorphism M_K → G'_K (14.1.6) lifting p'_K : M_K → B'_K.
- That lifting is claimed to coincide with the period map i'^an of the dual abelian variety A'_K, in the exact sequence 0 → M'_K → G'_K^an → A'_K^an → 0 (14.1.13).
- Grothendieck leaves the sign unsettled: 'à moins que ce ne soit l'opposé ???'.

Purpose: relating the uniformization data to the monodromy pairing and biextensions in SGA 7 IX.
errors: No mathematical error. The sign in the duality between i and i'^an is explicitly left open ('???'). That is a matter of convention, later fixed in the degeneration theory of Mumford, Faltings–Chai and Bosch–Lütkebohmert.

ideas.what: Rigid-analytic uniformization of semistable abelian varieties G_K^an/M_K ≅ A_K^an, uniqueness of the uniformizing map via connectedness
Period homomorphism i as a trivialization of the biextension of (M, M') by G_m, equivalently a lift of p' : M → B' to G'

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a typescript sheet of the published SGA 7 Exposé IX, reused as scrap paper for the divided-power de Rham notes. Its content is published verbatim. The open questions it raises were addressed by later work: an algebraic description of the periods (Mumford's construction, Faltings–Chai degeneration data) and the duality and sign (Faltings–Chai, Bosch–Lütkebohmert).
transcription_corrections: The transcription is essentially accurate for this typed page.
Note that this is a typed SGA 7 IX page (p. 191, archive stamp 509), unrelated to the handwritten simplicial divided-power de Rham notes on the neighbouring pages.
